name: corps
description: Corporations (player orgs): found/join a corp, custom ranks, a shared atomic treasury, a private corp channel, and a claimable HQ. NPC factions share the unified orgs table. Also owns territory (zone_control tug-of-war), Corporate Assets (org_ventures — corp-owned operating businesses), and protection rackets (org_rackets) — a cut of every sale at a shop the corp leans on, whose fear decays on a half-life so the income dies unless somebody keeps walking the beat.

dataSchema.orgs: corp identity + treasury + tier; NPC factions share the table (is_npc=1)
dataSchema.org_ranks: per-corp custom ranks carrying a permission bitmask (server/engine/org-perms.js)
dataSchema.org_rackets: protection rackets on NPC shops. `fear` is stored AS OF `last_leaned_at` and never decayed by a write — the current value is computed on read by fearNow() (the player_npc_relations pattern). One racket per shop (UNIQUE npc_id).

extensionPoints.zone flags: claimable (a zone corps may take territory in — also implied by danger != safe); claimable_asset (a vacant business shell a corp may claim as a venture)
extensionPoints.npcs.vendor_credits: a racketed shop's till — the skim debits it, so the take is a transfer, not a faucet
